beats.en: 'Paraaparak Kanni' is composed by saint-poet Thayumanavar (who once served as chief accountant under King Vijayaraghunatha Chokkanathar of Tiruchirappalli). His collected songs are revered as 'தமிழ் மொழியின் உபநிடதம்'. '
